name: Dokidoki Sister Paradise
original_name: ドキドキしすたぁパラダイス
source:
The protagonist's parents go overseas to work, leaving him alone in Japan. He decides to move in with his cousins, but... he doesn't know how beautiful they all are! Better yet, all of them are head over heels for him! That fateful summer, at a restaurant called Corretto, a story full of slapstick humor and sexy yet cute scenes will play out! Who will our main character end up with?

[Translated from [url=http://www.light.gr.jp/light/products/sister]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公的父母前往海外工作，把他独自留在日本。他决定搬去与表姐妹们同住，却不知道她们个个都如此美丽！更棒的是，她们全都深深迷恋着他！在那个命运般的夏天，一段充满滑稽闹剧与性感可爱场面的故事，将在名为Corretto的餐厅上演！主人公最终会与谁走到一起？

[翻译自[url=http://www.light.gr.jp/light/products/sister]官方网站[/url]]
